subject: Security deliverables for contract signature - LedgerTech
messages:
From: Sarah Conley <sarah.conley@ledgertech.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@ledgertech.com>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@ledgertech.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Security deliverables for contract signature - LedgerTech

Diego,

We're scheduled to finalize the MSA by the end of next week, but our legal and procurement teams need the penetration test documentation to complete the security review. Specifically:

- A penetration test report (redacted for public disclosure if necessary) covering the surface area used by LedgerTech integrations.
- An executive summary we can share with the board and procurement.
- Confirmation of remediation status for any critical/urgent findings.

Our timeline is tight: procurement needs the files and a point-of-contact for follow ups by EOD Monday, 13 May. If we can't provide evidence by then, the contracting team will push signature to the June review.

Can you confirm what's available and whether you can provide redacted artifacts?

Thanks,
Sarah Conley
Head of Procurement
LedgerTech

Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet - referenced)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Conley <sarah.conley@ledgertech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security deliverables for contract signature - LedgerTech

Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answer: yes, we can provide a redacted penetration test report and an exec summary. Plan below.

High-level plan:
- We will provide a redacted PDF of the pen test covering the customer-facing surface used in your integration (auth endpoints, ingestion pipeline, SSO flow).
- We'll include a 1-page executive brief summarizing scope, test window, high/medium/low findings, and remediation status.
- For any critical findings that required emergency patches, we'll include an attest statement and change ticket references.

Timeline and deliverables:
- Draft redacted report + exec brief: Monday, 13 May by 17:00 PT.
- Final artifacts (with any additional QA redactions): Wednesday, 15 May by 12:00 PT.
- POC for follow-ups: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — she'll handle any technical Qs and evidence requests.

A couple of clarifying questions to ensure the redaction level is acceptable:
1) Do you require full vulnerability details (CVE, exact payloads) or high-level classifications and impacted components?
2) Will procurement accept a redacted PDF plus the executive summary, or do you need the original report under an NDA?

I'll coordinate with Rishi (security) and Laura (legal) to ensure we meet your gating needs.

— Diego
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Sarah Conley <sarah.conley@ledgertech.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@ledgertech.com>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@ledgertech.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security deliverables for contract signature - LedgerTech

Thanks Diego. Procurement will accept a redacted PDF plus the exec summary for now — we prefer redaction over an additional NDA step. For severity details, please include CVE numbers where applicable but redact exploit payloads and internal IPs.

Also: if there are open critical findings, we need an explicit remediation ETA and evidence the fix is in QA or prod.

Sarah

---
Procurement note: deadline for gating evidence is EOD Monday, 13 May. If materials arrive late, the contracting review will be deferred.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Conley <sarah.conley@ledgertech.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security deliverables for contract signature - LedgerTech

Diego/Marissa — we completed the redaction pass this morning and uploaded an evidence bundle to the secure drive. Summary of items in bundle:

- LedgerTech_PT_Redacted_2028-04.pdf (redacted penetration test report)
- PT-Summary-Executive-2028-04.docx (1-page executive brief)
- Change tickets: CHG-9872 (auth patch), CHG-9901 (rate limiting hardening)
- Remediation attest: critical findings remediated and verified in staging on 2028-05-05; code roll to prod on 2028-05-09.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/secure/ledgertech/pt-summary-2028

Notes on redaction: we removed internal hostnames, test-user payloads, and PoC exploit strings. CVE references are retained where public. If LedgerTech needs the unredacted report under an executed DPA/NDA, we can initiate that separately.

Marissa will be the point-of-contact for any follow-up technical questions.

— Rishi
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: LedgerTech_PT_Redacted_2028-04.pdf (PDF), PT-Summary-Executive-2028-04.docx (DOCX)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Conley <sarah.conley@ledgertech.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@ledgertech.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security deliverables for contract signature - LedgerTech

Sarah / Tom — thanks for the quick coordination. Per procurement's request, please find the redacted bundle at the Drive link Rishi shared. Quick checklist for procurement intake:

- Executive brief (attached): single page, suitable for legal and exec review.
- Redacted PT report: includes scope, methodology, findings, and remediation notes.
- Remediation evidence: change ticket IDs and verification notes included in the report appendices.
- POC: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com), +1 (415) 555-0182.

If this satisfies gating, can procurement confirm receipt and whether we can proceed to signature? If there's any outstanding ask (e.g., additional attestations or an unredacted review under NDA), flag it here and we'll escalate to Legal.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PT-Summary-Executive-2028-04.docx (1 page)
